settings.notificationsDesc: Show a toast when an entry changes

home.title: Home
home.heading: Surfaces under test
home.intro: The test app for the LoomWeaver platform. Every surface here exists to exercise one platform feature, not to look like a product.
home.paneOpenTwo: Open two entries from the entry list on the left. Every pane is a tab group with its own strip.
home.paneDrag: Drag an entry tab to a pane edge to place it beside another one. The tab moves; the group keeps the rest.
home.paneMenu: Right-click a tab and pick Split right or Split down for the same result from the menu.
home.paneAdaptive: Drag the entry list itself into the centre: the same view switches to a card grid, because it lays itself out from the width it is given.
home.paneDirty: Start typing a draft, then switch tabs. The draft survives, and closing the tab asks before discarding it.
home.detailsBody: The entries are a plugin; the panes, tabs, palette, settings and theming around them are the platform. Every control on this page is either a plain CSS class on a native element or a small <lw-*> web component where no native element exists.

tab.revealed: Revealed the entry in the list

dash.title: Dashboard
dash.exportIntro: Pick a range to see a disabled action with a stated reason.
dash.exportNote: Disabled in the testbed — there is no backend behind it.

search.title: Search
search.heading: Search
search.intro: A group-less perspective: it owns the whole content area and has no tab strip. Switching to it and back is what the perspective tests exercise.

notes.title: Notes
notes.heading: Notes
notes.intro: Saves itself the moment it is hidden (saveOn: 'hide'), so nothing is lost without a dialog.

sandbox.title: Sandbox (iframe)
sandbox.toast: Sandbox plugin activated — ctx over iframe + Penpal RPC.

auth.droppedAdmin: Admin role dropped — now a plain user.

cmd.resetConfirm: **All items** will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.

owner.body: Two facets of one owner: pick an owner on either tab and the other follows, because the host substitutes the parameter value it knows by name.

login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Sign in to continue

workspace.title: Containers
workspace.auditIntro: A container child gated to the admin role. It is seeded into the arrangement whatever the session, so its pane shows the access placeholder until an admin signs in.

escalations.title: Admin route
escalations.intro: Reachable only with the admin role. Everyone else gets the placeholder or the login redirect, depending on the route.
